messages:
laura-cs: FYI sending final renewal docs to AcmeCorp now — need invoice mapped to EU billing entity before I hit Docusign.

mike-legal: Quick Q — billing entity to use is 'AcmeCorp EU BV' (VAT registered), not Acme Inc, yes?

emma-accounting: Confirmed: AcmeCorp EU BV. VAT applies. Will attach PO and invoice PDF in a minute. invoice ref 2026-4991.

laura-cs: Awesome. Also theres a signer mismatch: procurement listed John Li but sales pointed to Sujan Patel. who signs?

sanjay-ops: @emma-accounting can you confirm vendor_code so procurement routing matches? otherwise envelope will bounce.

emma-accounting: vendor_code: V-9981. uploading PO: https://drive.redwood.ai/links/acme-po-4991 (preview attached).

laura-cs: I'll prepare envelope but will hold send until legal gives green light on clause changes. Docusign draft link: https://docusign.com/envelope/0Abc123 (draft).

mike-legal: Sales asked for term change to 9 months (was 12). I need to swap clause 4.2 wording and update SOW. Sales confirmed pricing stays same.

laura-cs: OK set term=9mo. I'll set signer order: 1) John Li (primary) 2) Sujan Patel (cc). If legal needs different signer roles, flag now.

docusign-bot: Envelope 0Abc123 status: created by laura-cs — recipients pending.

emma-accounting: I've attached invoice PDF and PO. Please add billing reference INV-2026-4991-EU to the envelope metadata for our AP system.

laura-cs: Done — added billing ref INV-2026-4991-EU and vendor_code V-9981 to envelope fields. Holding send until mike-legal confirms redlines applied. :white_check_mark:

docusign-bot: Envelope 0Abc123 status: ready-to-send (awaiting manual send).

mike-legal: I pushed updated clause and SOW into the draft. No further redlines expected. give me 10m to sanity-check the signature block.

laura-cs: thanks — i'll queue the send after your OK. also pinging @sanjay-ops in case we need to clamp routing if signers change.

sanjay-ops: standing by. if the signer list changes after send we can suspend and re-route but prefers to avoid churn.

laura-cs: Sending now. :paperplane:

docusign-bot: Envelope 0Abc123 status: sent to John Li (action: signing required).

mike-legal: Noted. I'll watch for any redline request from their counsel.

laura-cs: I'll update thread when signed or if AP reports mismatch. thanks all.
